# Editsfield AI

> Editsfield AI is a free, browser-based AI video editor for narration-led creator videos. Upload images or clips, a voiceover and a JSON/SRT script; it syncs scenes to the voiceover, adds motion, transitions, captions, music ducking and color grading, and exports an MP4. No sign-up, no watermark pricing — free to use.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no account required
- Platform: web browser (desktop recommended)
- Inputs: images, video clips, voiceover audio, JSON or SRT timing script
- Output: MP4 at 720p, 1080p or 4K
- Aspect ratios: 16:9 (YouTube), 9:16 (Shorts, TikTok, Reels), 1:1, 4:5
- Features: script-driven scene timing, Ken Burns motion, transition packs (Mixed, Smooth, Dynamic, Minimal, Professional), captions (fade, slide, typewriter, karaoke), lower thirds, callouts, date stamps, quote cards, background music with auto-ducking, loudness normalization, color grading presets
- Contact: support@editsfieldai.online
